original_factor_provenance: The archived 0.1632 multiplier was hardcoded. No component decomposition was established; the new parameters do not assume it equals 0.20*0.85*0.96.

engineering_parameters.model: GHI-proportional AC electricity availability from DC nameplate capacity
engineering_parameters.dc_capacity_mapping: MWp/dc retains raw MW; MWac converts raw MW * 1.2; unknown is assumed DC and retains raw MW
engineering_parameters.ac_capacity_mapping: C_ac_MW = C_dc_MW / 1.2; explicitly reported MWac is retained exactly
engineering_parameters.aggregation: AC clipping is applied to each phase-hour; phase powers are summed by project, then averaged over three-hour periods
engineering_parameters.model_capacity_mw: Solar capacity_mw is the summed project AC power limit; the source values remain in capacity_raw_mw
engineering_parameters.scope: Simplified GHI-proportional resource model using documented PVWatts default engineering parameters. No module efficiency multiplier, temperature model, transposition model, or full PVWatts simulation is applied.

primary_sources.supports: Default system losses 14%; inverter efficiency separately defaults to 96%; inverter losses are excluded from system losses
PVWatts V8 dc_ac_ratio default 1.2 and inv_eff default 96
DC nameplate power is electrical power at STC; AC inverter rating equals DC nameplate divided by DC/AC ratio; module efficiency defines area rather than another multiplier on nameplate power
GEM retains phase-specific AC/DC/unknown capacity ratings; the unknown-to-DC assignment here is a declared study assumption
